objective: Generate and statically falsify exactly three object-first, exponent-targeting prime-field ECDLP mechanisms, selecting at most one for a future specification while authorizing zero implementation and zero experiment runs.

candidates.title: Three-way lossy-object frontier for a charged prime-field ECDLP exponent route
candidates.uncertainty: Whether any genuinely lossy, publicly computable object outside the excluded established lenses propagates through elliptic-curve operations while retaining enough target-dependent information for a decoder whose end-to-end classical cost is plausibly below Pollard rho.
candidates.positive_decision: If one candidate survives both independent review-breakthrough/max reports without an immediate circularity, observation collision, baseline, quantifier, or cost-model break, preserve it as proposed and recommend one separately authorized specification batch; do not implement here.
candidates.negative_decision: If every candidate breaks, record the exact derived obstruction and resource reversal for each object without claiming the ECDLP space is closed.
candidates.inconclusive_decision: Preserve incomparable or source-unresolved candidates as unverified and name one cheapest missing discriminant; do not promote or implement.
candidates.next_action: Generate exactly three proposals, snapshot them, run mutually blind max-tier Validator and Red Team reviews, and ledger-dispose.

ambiguities.question: Can this batch establish exhaustive novelty while the derived KB collection is unavailable?
ambiguities.resolution: No. Direct repository and retrieved primary-source reads may identify duplicates or known mechanisms, but every surviving novelty claim remains unverified unless a directly read source supports a narrower known or adaptation label.
ambiguities.basis: The KB search failed because the configured in-memory collection does not exist; AGENTS.md states that absence of retrieval is not evidence of absence.

ambiguities.question: How is a conditional exponent point ranked when data, preprocessing, or another cost coordinate is unknown?
ambiguities.resolution: It is incomparable on the Pareto frontier and cannot dominate or be dominated using that unknown coordinate.
ambiguities.basis: Pareto dominance requires a comparison on every declared cost axis; BATCH-c36939 Red Team finding J6 rejected domination claims over unknown axes.

candidates.dominated_by: n/a (no result claimed); current realized attack remains Pollard rho. Conditional candidate points are incomparable until every time, memory, preprocessing, data/query, retry, and verification axis is known.

sota_delta.note: No attack exists at opening. A proposal may state a conditional delta only with every unknown axis explicitly marked.

attention_contract.decisive_evidence: Three schema-complete proposal records, a direct-source audit, a complete proof-search portfolio, a blind statement packet, a selection report, and fresh mutually blind review-breakthrough/max verdicts that attack disjoint load-bearing joints.
attention_contract.inconclusive_decision: No implementation or execution admission; name the narrowest unresolved structural or cost obligation.
attention_contract.local_ambiguity_rule: Any reversible object, hidden oracle, uncharged preprocessing, missing target decoder, observation collision, false baseline embedding, unknown axis used as domination, or quantifier dependence outside the claim forces REVISE or no selection.
attention_contract.rerank_trigger: Both independent max-tier reviews and the Coordinator disposition are ledger-archived.

resource_estimate.dominant_cost: Object-first proposal derivation, direct-source and repository prior-art audit, proof-search falsification, two independent max-tier reviews, and exact archival.
resource_estimate.complexity_hypothesis: Zero experimental computation; symbolic derivation and primary-source retrieval only.
resource_estimate.sharding_plan: One Idea Generator runs first; the Validator and Red Team may run concurrently only after one immutable snapshot; archive tasks run alone.
resource_estimate.stop_rule: Stop the producer after exactly three candidates and at most one selection; stop a candidate immediately on reversible-object, hidden-oracle, baseline, quantifier, or end-to-end cost failure; stop the batch after two terminal reviews and one ledger disposition.

stages.purpose: Validate and snapshot the batch-58 control plane.
stages.dominant_operation: Schema, focus, dispatch, ledger, ID, Git, and runtime binding checks.
stages.stop_rule: Stop on any authority, parse, budget, collision, or branch-binding failure.

stages.purpose: Generate and cheaply falsify three distinct lossy-object mechanisms.
stages.dominant_operation: Symbolic mechanism derivation, repository/source audit, proof-search maps, and charged frontier comparison.
stages.stop_rule: Stop after exactly three schema-complete proposals and at most one conditional selection.

stages.purpose: Blindly rederive load-bearing costs and adversarially attack object novelty, circularity, and Pareto claims.
stages.dominant_operation: Two fresh mutually blind review-breakthrough/max reviews.
stages.stop_rule: Stop after both terminal verdicts; no reviewer composes the whole-claim disposition.

stages.purpose: Snapshot and ledger-archive the exact bounded disposition.
stages.dominant_operation: Exact path, hash, parent, independence, ledger, and Git verification.
stages.stop_rule: Stop on mismatch; otherwise after verified terminal queue binding.

claims.statement: At least one genuinely lossy, publicly computable elliptic-curve object outside the excluded established lenses may admit a falsifiable propagation law and a fully charged target decoder worth future specification.
claims.scope: Zero-experiment object-first proposal generation and pre-implementation static review only.
claims.target_result: At most one proposed candidate with complete proof-search and cost obligations, or three explicit scoped obstruction records.
